entry.title: I Just Launched My First Micro SaaS 🚀
entry.summary:
For a long time, I’ve had this dream: build something for myself. As a software developer, most of my time is spent working on client projects and meeting tight deadlines — but outside of work, I’ve always wanted a side hustle. I explored ideas, scrolled through social media, and brainstormed countless times. Eventually, I realized something: there’s no “perfect” idea. The best way to start is simply to start. So, I decided to build something small, useful, and privacy-focused — a micro SaaS. I built a micro SaaS application called CodeShareScribe. The core purpose is simple: create and share content anonymously with the receiver, while enhancing privacy through end-to-end encryption in private mode. A few key features: No login? You can still send up to 3 contents.
Free plan? Log in and share more than 15 contents.
Paid plans? Coming soon! They’ll include password-protected encrypted messages, where only the receiver with the correct password can unlock the content.
File sharing? Also coming soon.
Subscription Plans
FREE – Send up to 15 contents (after login).
UNLIMITED – In progress.
PRO – In progress. Includes encryption with a sender-set password.
In the paid plans, all data is encrypted using the password you choose. The receiver can unlock it using that same password. This keeps your data private and secure — even from us. I’ve built a feedback panel so anyone can share ideas, report bugs, or ask questions. Every bit of feedback helps me improve the app and make it more stable, user-friendly, and fun to use. Right now, this is just the MVP — your ideas can help shape the official release! Here’s the link to try it out: paste-scribe I’m excited to keep building, adding features, and learning along the way.
If you’re curious about privacy-first tools or just want to send something anonymously — give it a try and let me know what you think.
